title: Recording decisions and formal risk acceptance

videos.script: Every threat at the clinic now has an answer, except one. A crafted PDF that could attack a clinic computer. The only fix costs more than the risk. {{one}} So the clinic is going to live with it. That is a legitimate decision. What is not legitimate is making it in a corridor and forgetting it. {{corridor}} A risk is accepted in writing, by the person who owns it, with what is in place instead and a date to look again. {{writing}} Today you write that record and keep it in git, beside the model. Then a short program reads every decision and says which ones are due. One of them is already five days late. {{late}} By the end you will know why accepted risks rot, and the three habits that stop them. {{rot}}
